title: GAAI portable pre-merge proof contract
description: Two named schemas: $defs/trust_manifest (base-held policy, read from the base commit B, never from a PR copy) and $defs/verdict (the full merge-proof verdict a verifier emits after independently resolving Git state and cross-checking caller-supplied CI evidence). Consumers reference a fragment, e.g. premerge-policy.schema.json#/$defs/trust_manifest.

reason_enum.description: Stable, closed terminal-reason taxonomy. Priority-check order (first match wins) lives in the verifier, not the schema: schema_invalid, environment_error, commit_unresolvable, identity_mode_conflict, tuple_forged, parent_mismatch, tree_mismatch, manifest_digest_mismatch, trust_surface_changed, run_attempt_mismatch, job_missing, job_duplicate, job_not_success.

trust_manifest.title: trust_manifest
trust_manifest.description: Versioned JSON trust manifest, resolvable only from the base commit B. Defines schema/policy versions, digest algorithm, workflow identity, trust-covered paths, the complete required-job set, the validation profile, and an optional rollover approval reference.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the manifest instance conforms to (e.g. "1.0.0").

policy_version.description: Version of the policy content itself, independent of schema_version.

digest_algorithm.description: Canonical digest algorithm. Closed to sha256 in this schema version.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the trusted validation workflow (e.g. .github/workflows/test-gate.yml).

name.description: Human-readable workflow name as declared in the workflow file.

covered_paths.description: Repository-relative paths that must be byte-identical between the base commit B and the synthetic merge commit T for the base to remain a trust root (AC3).

required_jobs.description: The complete set of job names that must each appear exactly once with a successful conclusion (AC5).

validation_profile.description: Identifier of the validation profile this manifest enforces (e.g. "standard").

rollover_approval_ref.description: Optional reference (e.g. a human-approval artefact or commit) authorizing a change to this manifest's own trust-covered content.

verdict.title: verdict
verdict.description: Full merge-proof verdict binding repository, PR-or-merge-group identity, B/H/T/tree(T), workflow/run identity, run_attempt, event, manifest digest, validation profile, and every required job (AC4).

mode.description: Provenance mode. A merge_group verdict cannot be confused with a pull_request verdict (AC2).

identity.description: Mode-shaped identity block. oneOf enforces schema-level rejection of a mismatched shape (e.g. mode=merge_group carrying pr_number).

merge_sha.description: T — resolved synthetic merge commit; parents(T) == (B, H) in order for pull_request mode.

tree_sha.description: tree(T) — the tree object of the synthetic merge commit.

manifest_digest.description: Canonical sha256 digest of the trust_manifest read from B.

x_extensions.description: The single explicitly-allowed schema extension point on verdict (AC4). Free-form; not validated further.
